description: One hop out from a ref, grouped by module: catalogue (listing, product), fulfilment (ZobShip order with AWB), returns, money (settlement it was paid in, claims), books (Tally voucher), stock (warehouse levels), intel. Each group says how fresh it is. Works for order, order-line, product, listing and settlement refs. An order line with no settlement in its money group has not been paid yet.
